tool_parameters.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: a single premium game UI icon texture, isolated on a truly transparent RGBA background, for a small view-switch button on a dark jade-green Chinese fantasy dossier panel.
Primary request: one small five-petal plum/cherry-blossom shaped button seen perfectly straight on. Exactly five gently rounded petals, clearly separated by shallow inward notches. A small round bronze-gold center. Symmetrical balanced silhouette; one petal points upward.
Style: restrained refined Chinese fantasy game interface, finely crafted tactile shallow bas-relief. Petals are matte deep oxblood red lacquer/enamel with tiny subtle organic engraved veins and delicate wear. A slender aged-gold bronze rim follows the outside of every petal, with fine narrow internal separators. It should harmonize with an old gold framed dark green parchment panel and existing red/gold blossom controls.
Lighting: soft diffuse light from upper left; dark warm recesses, muted restrained gold highlights. Clear shape readable at 40 CSS pixels.
Composition: one icon centered, icon occupies about 84 percent of a square canvas, even transparent breathing room all around. No perspective tilt, no pedestal, no cast shadow outside the flower.
Constraints: the output is ONLY the flower button graphic. True transparent background. No text, no letters, no arrows, no UI panel, no page or screenshot, no separate other icons, no outline square, no sparkle, no gemstone, no glow, no sparkles, no pink hearts, no stems, no ribbons. Render at the highest available fidelity.
